purpose: INCLUAI is an inclusive workplace intelligence platform that provides AI‑driven assistance, policy guidance, reporting, and analytics to promote equity and accessibility within an organization.
objectives: Enable employees to access company policies and support resources instantly.
Provide real‑time AI Copilot for queries, document drafting, and navigation.
Collect anonymous barrier reports with zero‑retaliation guarantees.
Offer managers dashboards and analytics on inclusion metrics and SLA performance.

features.copilot: AI chat interface powered by Gemini, supports policy answers, email drafts, rewrites, and project guidance.
features.dashboard: Admin knowledge dashboard for uploading documents, managing sources, and viewing usage stats.
features.reports: Anonymous reporting system with cryptographic hashing and secure storage.
features.dataset: Explorer for employee, task, and policy data stored in encrypted JSON DB.
features.auth: JWT based authentication with role‑based access control (Employee, HR_Admin, Organization_Admin).

architecture.frontend: Static HTML/JS served from /public, uses fetch to call /api/v2 endpoints, includes Three.js background.
architecture.backend: Node.js Express server (server.js) exposing versioned API under /api/v2, uses services for AI, RAG, DB, auth.
architecture.database: JSON file data/db.json accessed via services/dbService.js, contains users, documents, reports, tasks, notifications, conversations.
architecture.ai: services/aiService.js orchestrates intent detection, RAG lookup, Gemini live calls, web search fallback, conversation history.
architecture.rag: services/ragService.js performs simple token similarity; will be enhanced with embeddings.
architecture.embeddings: services/embeddingService.js generates Gemini embeddings and stores them in data/embeddings.json.

workflows.employee_query: User sends chat → AI Service retrieves recent conversation, performs intent detection, fetches relevant docs (project knowledge + company docs), calls Gemini, returns response with citations.
workflows.admin_upload: Admin uses /api/v2/knowledge/upload (multipart) → file parsed, text extracted, embedding stored, document entry added to DB.
workflows.report_submission: Anonymous user fills form → server strips identifiers, stores hashed report, notifies admins.
